description: Land Title Settlement Department - Galamuna, Lankapura D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District - Cad. Map No. 120280 (7604)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, specifically addressing changes in land ownership records where properties are being transferred to state ownership. The content includes detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their locations, cadastral references, and amendments to ownership records - all of which fall squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
